title: Runaway Process
description: A CLI Quest worker is repeatedly consuming CPU in the background.
mission: Use process inspection tools to find the worker associated with this workspace and terminate it.

lesson.what_happened: A background helper repeatedly performed work and consumed CPU.
lesson.be_careful: Verify the full command and workspace before terminating it.

files.content: The runaway worker command includes both '__runaway' and this workspace path.

hints: Inspect running processes and their CPU usage.
ps aux can show both the command and CPU column. Look for __runaway.
Confirm the process command contains this workspace path before using kill on its PID.
